final: WITH j AS (SELECT ft.invoice_number AS inv, c.gender AS g, ft.transaction_amount AS amt FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id), inv_avg AS (SELECT inv, g, AVG(amt) AS a FROM j GROUP BY inv, g), g_avg AS (SELECT g, AVG(a) AS ga FROM inv_avg GROUP BY g), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS oa FROM g_avg), kept AS (SELECT g_avg.ga AS ga, g_avg.ga - overall.oa AS ex FROM g_avg, overall WHERE g_avg.ga > overall.oa) SELECT AVG(ga) AS avg_kept_gender_avg, AVG(ex) AS avg_excess FROM kept
